import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import unittest

from app import summarize


class SummaryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_json_list_command(self):
        result = subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, "-B", str(Path(__file__).with_name("app.py"))],
            input="[]",
            text=True,
            capture_output=True,
            check=True,
        )
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(result.stdout), {"count": 0, "average": 0})

    def test_nonempty(self):
        self.assertEqual(summarize([2, 4, 6]), {"count": 3, "average": 4})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
